scope: Read-only bounded review of the frozen SOURCE-CAPTURE-R1 contract; no source, Git, Vault, or external process mutation.
actual_bounded_review: Five closed objects have explicit bindings and preserve legacy PDF, code, ingest-plan, approval-ref, paper-record, Docling, and evidence-locator contracts.
The capture target is digest-addressed .raw/captured/<sha>.md; Markdown inspection must reject same-digest alternate-extension siblings and preserve raw bytes.
The plan/ref/request/authority flow keeps external approval separate from agent validation and keeps capture staging separate from first canonical source-ledger ingest.

The first admit requires an externally bound generic capture operation result and current retained bytes; it does not invent or require a canonical capture receipt because capture transactions cannot publish one.
Admission identifiers are a distinct new ingest batch/operation, and nullable hash-only original PDF provenance does not authorize reading or copying PDF bytes.
The packet specifies retained descriptor lineage, complete-set checks, all-exits verification, exact idempotence/conflict cases, and no agent-side Vault mutation.

The separate allowlist freezes exactly 24 writable paths: five engine schemas, three engine Markdown modules plus contracts registry, research formal-source/CLI, five schema fixtures, fixture helper, four focused suites, quickstart, and the formal-source skill/reference.
review_notes: Implementation acceptance must verify the .md override on missing and reuse paths, alternate-extension conflicts, bound result path/hash/mode checks, current orphan snapshot checks, and batch/operation binding.
